'''Yoko''' (Japanese: '''シザーズヨウコ''' ''Scissors Yōko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM124|Living on the Cutting Edge!]]''. She is the final character of the day to appear in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''.

Yoko is a Pokémon stylist who has her own trimming salon in [[Hau'oli City]]. She was about to trim three {{p|Furfrou}} when a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Kartana}} entered her salon. Kartana quickly trimmed the Furfrou, leaving them to resemble {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Vulpix}} and {{p|Ninetales}}, and {{p|Arceus}}, respectively. Yoko screamed out of shock, which was overheard by {{an|Lillie}}, who happened to be looking for Kartana. She then explained what happened to Lillie, and although she appeared to be unhappy with the Furfrou's new trims, the Furfrou were quite pleased.
